question: Chemical formula of quick lime is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**CaO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The chemical formula for calcium oxide is CaO.
 
• It is also known as quicklime, burnt lime, or quicklime.
 
• It reacts with water to form calcium hydroxide.
